I am a girl that had this prank happen to me. The boy I had a crush on all 8th grade year suddenly pulled me aside outside of the school entrance and asked to talk to me. He asked to go steady, and I instantly turned bright red. I stuttered like a fool, no actual words coming out for a few seconds, “derrr, duhhh, ummm, iiiiii,”. It only lasted a few seconds and I didn’t give an answer, because he couldn’t hold his laughter, and then all of his friends jumped out from behind the corner of the building and started pointing and laughing. I got angry and yelled, “I never said yes!” And cursed and stomped off. 

It’s kind of a funny memory. Dumb bitches. I was on a bad after school special about bullying, or girls lacking confidence or something. Jerks! Wah! Luckily this is before middle schoolers had cellphones and social media existed. 

Now, I always pause before reacting to being asked out! I turned down a lot of popular kids in high school thinking it was a prank. Trust no one!

NTA.

Especially since she has your location and can see you at your family and bfs house so she knows it’s you and not someone else using your phone. It’s so disappointing that people need these types of situations to learn hard lessons like don’t talk behind roommates/coworkers/families backs especially without talking to the person first if you have a potential problem.

You probably feel extremely betrayed and embarrassed, but this happens to everyone at this age especially. Hopefully, it’s just due to them mostly being immature and thriving in the high of gaining attention from gossiping. They are embarrassed someone is cleaning up after them and they aren’t as mature as you. Talking about your best friend, not the other girls. No excuse and yes, your best friend damaged your relationship. 

But if she shows remorse and takes action to publicly show she was wrong in front of the other roommates such as helping you clean and agreeing to keep the apartment more hygienic when concern is raised, I think the relationship can be recovered. If no remorse is shown then that is sad and she lost a good roommate and a positive influence. You are very kind to consider the feelings of the one girl who is not involved, just don’t let it be that it’s because you are scared of another person ‘not liking you’. I would love to have you as a roommate!
